notes.title: Performance Optimization + Visual Upgrade + Animation Update
notes.notes:
Performance Optimization + Visual Upgrade + Animation Update

[previewyoutube=SE8t5viofnQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone! We're excited to announce a significant update to the game, focusing on three key areas: **performance optimization, visual enhancements, and animation improvements**.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868989/bad9822be9347598d06f586e8395d82cc899ad86.png

*Performance Optimization*  
• Removed the old performance-heavy post-processing filters and replaced them with new, nearly zero-cost alternatives  
• Significantly reduced default camera draw distance, now with adjustable options in *Camera Settings*  
  • Recommended setting for mid/low-end PCs: 100 meters  
• Added a new *pre-loading system* before scenes begin, showing players which game systems are being prepared in the background  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868989/15341c72d096abbd6ca5555739630a032238e7c8.png

*Visual Upgrades*  
• Implemented new *post-processing filters* (performance-friendly) with customizable parameters in Settings  
• Enhanced *volumetric fog* for better distant-view effects  
• Added *volumetric lighting* (visually impactful but low-performance cost)  
• Updated select vegetation, buildings, and terrain textures  
• Revamped lighting/water effects in certain scenes, fixing visual bugs  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868989/0845788a6a7d641673d619dbc76d14e634fa4a9f.png

*Animation Updates*  
• Overhauled *weapon idle/aiming/movement animations* for the protagonist  
• Updated **explosion VFX**, including:  
  • Smoke grenades, bombs, grenades, blood effects, and other particle systems  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868989/cf4be55c798073dc0671abbf2cefaabd9de10b26.png

*Patch Notes*  
1. *Post-processing filters* and graphics settings redesigned  
2. Replaced rifle/shotgun idle animations; fixed rifle animation bugs  
3. Added **volumetric fog/lighting**; updated some plant models  
4. Replaced high-resource buildings; adjusted scene lighting  
5. Minor terrain modifications in select areas  
6. Added *FOV/draw distance slider* in settings  
7. Better optimization for varying PC specs  
8. Optimized **object pooling**, loading configs, and NPC spawning  
9. Updated *explosion particle effects*  
10. Miscellaneous bug fixes  

Thank you for your continued support! Wishing you good health and success in your endeavors!

notes.title: About the recent official Unity update announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868989/4234cf97d690c3ebcc87bff3f602e9e4bbd21790.png
 Hello, dear players! 
You've all heard about the recent official Unity update announcement.
Like most Unity developers and gamers, I was shocked.
We fully understand that Unity, as a business, needs to make money, and that's perfectly normal.
However, the use of a completely opaque installation number for the billing method is highly irrational.
I'm sure everyone was surprised and saddened by the news,
Unity is a great tool, and it has a huge market share.
Since the project was already live and there were many features in development, I couldn't replace the 3D engine halfway through
So at least to this day, I'm still working hard on optimization projects and feature development.
Maybe this will lead to new developments, maybe not
However, I will continue to work hard on the road of the game dream

 Hats off to the great players! Have a nice day.

notes.title: BUG Fixes and updates 2023-07-05
notes.notes:
BUG Fixes and updates 2023-07-05
Most effects are recycled using object pooling technology to avoid the performance cost of frequent creation and destruction of objects
1.  Remove excess physical collision of AI shells to reduce performance consumption
2.  Object pooling technology is used to optimize special effects and reduce performance consumption
3.  Fixed the outline display effect of infected persons
4.  Fixed the loot drop for common infected people
5.  Reduce excess particles of blood effect and reduce performance consumption
6.  Adjust the screen Settings, the maximum frame limit is 120 frames by default
It is recommended that the player set a maximum frame limit, too high a frame number will cause the graphics card fan to generate excess revolution increase the burden
Thank you for your support, I am still working hard!  Have a good day!
